name: Sigma Seven
about: Sigma Seven (1962 B DEL 1), a crewed vehicle (Mercury MA), launched 1962 Oct  3. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1962 Oct  3), held fixed
